name: empty
title: Empty
description: What a page or panel shows when it has nothing yet: a glyph tile, a title, one muted line and the next actions.
usage: Use for a page, table or panel with nothing in it yet, or nothing matching a search. Put a GlyphTile (or EmptyMedia variant icon with a line glyph) in EmptyMedia, a short title in EmptyTitle, one line of why or what next in EmptyDescription, and the actions (the brand button first) in EmptyContent, with anything quieter (a usage line) after them. Use variant outline for an empty panel inside a busy page. EmptyState (product) is the same look with props; Empty is the composable version.
avoid: A moving illustration other than the glyph's own loop

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
